paragraph: [From 10 January 2025, FAS said, Kwenda cash transfers were paid into the personal bank accounts of 91 households in Cabinda](<https://fasangola.com/pt/2025/01/11/kwenda-avanca-com-transferencia-monetaria-as-contas-pessoais-dos-beneficiarios-em-cabinda/>). The households collect the money at ATMs and partner bank branches. In August 2023 [FAS director-general Jelembi said Kwenda payments over three years went 77% in cash and 23% by electronic card](<https://angop.ao/es/noticias/economia/programa-kwenda-entrega-mais-de-akz-44-mil-milhoes-as-familias/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 shows a second main government payment stream paid digitally. Operating would need two or more of social transfers, civil service salaries and pensions paid digitally.

In May 2026 the World Bank [said Merankabandi, a government cash transfer programme, has been nationwide since 2022 and has reached over 1.5 million people](<https://www.worldbank.org/en/results/2026/05/01/building-burundi-s-national-social-protection-systems-to-deliver-jobs-and-respond-to-crises>), backed by investments in digital payments. Merankabandi [paid selected refugees in Ruyigi 73,600 BIF every two months to their mobile phones](<https://www.sosmediasburundi.org/2025/09/22/buhumuza-clap-de-fin-pour-merankabandi-deux-annees-de-transferts-monetaires-qui-ont-transforme-la-vie-des-refugies/>). Nearly 8,000 households in five camps were paid this way until September 2025. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 shows a second main government payment stream paid digitally. Operating would need two or more of social transfers, civil service salaries and pensions paid digitally.

Since 18 September 2025 [GBESSOKE has paid monthly cash transfers to households' secured SIM cards](<https://www.gouv.bj/article/3265/mise-oeuvre-programme-gbessoke-transferts-monetaires-demarre-plus-mille-menages-deja-touches-/>). [Pensions under 50,000 FCFA go to mobile money accounts and larger ones by bank transfer](<https://matinlibre.com/2023/12/05/dematerialisation-du-paiement-des-pensions-de-retraite-au-benin-un-veritable-soulagement-malgre-des-couacs/>), Matin Libre reported in December 2023. In the last twelve months, a [September 2026 finance ministry circular](<https://www.gouv.bj/article/3677/finances-publiques-nouvelle-etape-franchie-dans-digitalisation-paiement-frais-mission/>) put official-mission expenses on electronic payment. No source found since October 2023 shows civil service salaries paid digitally. Mature would need a source from the past three years saying government payments to people are checked against the national ID or a social registry.

In January 2024 [the CNSS said it had moved many of its benefits from counter payment to bank transfer](<https://cnssbf.org/?p=8268>). It had [signed with Orange Money in May 2023](<https://cnssbf.org/?p=8268>) to pay pensions, family allowances and annuities to phones, step by step. In August 2024 [CARFO, the civil servants' pension fund, announced mobile money payment of pensions](<https://burkina24.com/2024/08/21/communique-carfo-a-partir-du-4eme-trimestre-2024-paiement-par-mobile-money-des-arrerages-de-pension-ou-de-rente-6/>) from the last quarter of 2024. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 shows CARFO's mobile payments made. Operating would need two or more of social transfers, civil service salaries and pensions paid digitally.

In May 2025 [food-voucher beneficiaries of a Ministry of Local Government programme received a monthly allowance on a SmartSwitch biometric smart card](<https://techafricanews.com/2025/05/28/smartswitch-botswana-pioneers-dignified-digital-aid-for-75000-beneficiaries/>). The card replaced a paper-based food basket system and is used at over 1,200 shops. [More than 75,000 beneficiaries had made digital purchases at local stores with it](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202505/biometric-payment-card-system-pushing-financial-inclusion-in-botswana>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 shows a second main government payment stream paid digitally. Operating would need two or more of social transfers, civil service salaries and pensions paid digitally.

[The World Bank said in December 2024 that more civil servants had enrolled on Patapaye](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099122024184018568/txt/P1746201172f3b05d1a9d118f1eb4b91506.txt>), the government's mobile salary payment system. In August 2025 RFI reported that [administrations pay monthly salaries into bank accounts](<https://www.rfi.fr/fr/afrique/20250825-le-calvaire-de-ces-centrafricains-de-province-contraints-de-se-rendre-%C3%A0-bangui-pour-retirer-leur-salaire>), though provincial staff must travel to Bangui to draw them. In the last twelve months, a [March 2026 notice for the NDOYE safety-net project](<https://tenders.indexbox.io/tenders/selection-d-un-consultant-cabinet-pour-la-realisation-de-l-etude-de-faisabilite-et-b-op00430153>) sought a firm to set up a payment platform for its transfers. No source found since October 2023 shows social transfers or pensions paid digitally. Operating would need two or more of social transfers, civil service salaries and pensions paid digitally.

[APIF's 2024 report says the government's Programme Filets Sociaux Productifs pays quarterly allowances to rural households by mobile phone](<https://apif.finances.gouv.ci/images/app/publications/364/rapport-if-2024com.pdf>), with 230,000 active beneficiaries. In the last twelve months, in October 2026, [the BCEAO said the Treasury of Cote d'Ivoire has met all PI-SPI requirements and regularly makes bulk payments through the platform](<https://www.bceao.int/fr/communique-presse/connexion-des-tresors-publics-la-plateforme-interoperable-du-systeme-de-paiement>). The platform lets Treasuries send salaries, grants and subsidies to any account. No source found since October 2023 shows two or more main government payment streams paid digitally. Operating would need two or more of social transfers, civil service salaries and pensions paid digitally.

On 17 July 2026 the national coordinator of the MINEPAT Adaptive Social Safety Nets and Economic Inclusion Project (PFS-AIE) [awarded framework contracts for digital payments to the project's beneficiaries](<https://armp.cm/details?id_publication=36442&type_publication=COMM>). They cover cycle 8 of the TMO and phases 7 and 8 of the TMU. In 2020 [the government paid emergency COVID-19 transfers to 80,000 informal workers' mobile money accounts](<https://blogs.worldbank.org/fr/africacan/renforcer-la-resilience-comment-argent-mobile-transforme-la-reponse-aux-crises-au-cameroun>). In the last twelve months, in July 2026, the government contracted digital payment for project beneficiaries. No source found since October 2023 says a payment under the contracts has been made. Establishing would need a government social transfer, salary or pension paid digitally, in service.

In August 2025 the Ministry of Public Service said [civil servants' pay is delivered through bank accounts](<https://fonctionpublique.gouv.cd/fonction-publique-jean-pierre-lihau-trace-la-voie-dune-paie-modernisee-et-securisee/>), ten years after payroll bancarisation began. In the last twelve months, on 23 July 2026, CADECO, the public savings bank, and the Comité de suivi de la paie [validated the last adjustments for proximity pay of state agents in rural DRC](<https://actualite.cd/2026/07/24/paie-des-agents-publics-la-cadeco-et-le-csp-prets-lancer-la-paie-de-proximite-en-milieu>). The first operations were to cover several rural zones. No source found since October 2023 shows social transfers or pensions paid digitally. Operating would need two or more of social transfers, civil service salaries and pensions paid digitally.

In March 2025 [the World Bank said the government-launched Lisungi project introduced digital payments via mobile money for its cash transfers](<https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/feature/2025/03/27/afw-refugee-women-in-congo-are-planting-the-seeds-for-change-with-cash-transfers>). In June 2020 [a World Bank appraisal said Lisungi beneficiaries were paid in cash at Banque Postale du Congo branches](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/898141592839567766/pdf/Republic-of-Congo-Lisungi-Emergency-COVID-19-Response-Project.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 shows a second main government payment stream paid digitally. Operating would need two or more of social transfers, civil service salaries and pensions paid digitally.

[The PFSS-RRC says the World Bank-backed Mayendeleyo social cash transfer phase launched on 20 September 2026](<https://pfss-comores.org/articles/le-gouvernement-comorien-%C3%A9largit-la-protection-sociale-%C3%A0-55-000-m%C3%A9nages-vuln%C3%A9rables>), paying 55,000 households through the mobile-banking operators Mvula and Huri Money. [Africa24 TV says the Msaanda social cash transfers under the World Bank-financed PFSS-RRC (2023-2027) pay each beneficiary up to 75,000 KMF via mobile banking](<https://africa24tv.com/comores-financement-des-filets-sociaux-plus-de-40-000-menages-vulnerables-beneficiaires/>), reaching 40,010 households. In the last twelve months, the Mayendeleyo phase launched, on 20 September 2026. No source found since October 2023 shows a second main government payment stream paid digitally. Operating would need two or more of social transfers, civil service salaries and pensions paid digitally.

No stage is set. Nothing found since October 2023 says whether the government pays people digitally, in cash or by another route. The only name found is the [Cadastro Social Único](<https://www.cnps.cv/index.php/pt/86-noticias/130-governo-introduz-mais-3600-beneficiarios-no-rendimento-social-de-inclusao-emergencial>), and no source says how it pays. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found names a programme, salary or pension paid to people in either way. Absent would need a source from the past three years saying government payments to people are made in cash.

In March 2024 UNHCR said [158 refugee teachers from Ali Addeh and Holl-Holl are paid their salaries by bank transfer](<https://reliefweb.int/attachments/cdde8002-a416-4ea1-a6f9-05412c05d89c/HCR%20Djibouti_Operational%20Update_Mars%202024%20.pdf>). In November 2025 the Ministry of Budget [said it had signed a convention with the bank BCI to digitise the payment of civil servants' salaries](<https://www.linkedin.com/posts/minist%C3%A8re-du-budget-de-djibouti_budget-digitalisation-gouvernance-activity-7396655456540086272-U-c_>). The ministry gave no date for the first salaries paid under it. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 shows civil servants' salaries in general, social transfers or pensions paid digitally. Operating would need two or more of social transfers, civil service salaries and pensions paid digitally.

On 26 June 2024 the social insurance fund CNAS [signed a convention with Algérie Poste to digitise benefit transfers](<https://algerie-eco.com/2024/06/26/signature-dune-convention-sur-la-numerisation-des-virements-entre-la-cnas-et-algerie-poste/>) to insured people's CCP postal accounts. In April 2023 the labour minister said [1.9 million jobseekers get a monthly allowance paid into CCP accounts](<https://www.lejourdalgerie.com/versement-sur-les-comptes-ccp-le-ministre-devoile-un-nouveau-calendrier-pour-lallocation-chomage/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a payment under the convention has been made. Establishing would need a government social transfer, salary or pension paid digitally, in service.

[Finance Minister Mohamed Maait said e-payment of state payrolls grew 24% to EGP 299.4 billion](<https://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContent/3/12/525882/Business/Economy/Epayment,-collection-services-in-Egypt-rise-to-EGP.aspx>) in July 2023 to May 2024. From 15 August 2024 the Ministry of Social Solidarity [paid 5.2 million families](<https://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContent/1/2/530140/Egypt/Society/,-new-families-added-to-Takaful-amp;-Karama-cash-s.aspx>) Takaful and Karama cash support. Some were paid through Meeza bank cards. In the last twelve months, in May 2026, [it paid the support monthly into a mobile wallet on request](<https://www.elwatannews.com/news/details/8292004>). That is beside Meeza cards and the post. No source found since October 2023 says government payments are checked against the national ID or a social registry. Mature would need a source from the past three years saying they are.

No stage is set. Nothing found since October 2023 says whether the government pays people digitally. No programme, salary or pension paid to people has been found in any source, whether paid in cash or by another route. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Absent would need a source from the past three years saying government payments to people are made in cash.

In November 2024 [state ministers said the Productive Safety Net Programme had extended e-payment to 239 of its 492 woredas](<https://www.dpgethiopia.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/JRIS-Newsletter-Nov-2024-Final.pdf>). In the last twelve months, in July 2026, the finance ministry, the central bank and EthSwitch [convened government technical teams on interoperable government payments](<https://www.findevgateway.org/news/ethiopia-advances-nationwide-rollout-of-interoperable-digital-government-payments>). In May 2026 [the World Bank said its G2Px programme had helped 1.3 million Ethiopian households move to digital payments](<https://www.worldbank.org/en/results/2026/05/06/global-digital-public-infrastructure-program>), naming no programme. No source found since October 2023 shows civil service salaries or pensions paid digitally. Operating would need two or more of social transfers, civil service salaries and pensions paid digitally.

In late October 2025 the government [began a pilot to digitise social and tax payments, Ecofin Agency reported](<https://www.ecofinagency.com/news-digital/1112-51310-gabon-speeds-up-digital-payments-rollout-with-madigipaie-program>). [Full deployment was scheduled for January 2026](<https://www.ecofinagency.com/news-digital/1112-51310-gabon-speeds-up-digital-payments-rollout-with-madigipaie-program>). In the last twelve months, on 19 December 2025, [the CNSS began paying 3,010 maternity and old-age single-entitlement benefits](<https://gabonactu.com/blog/2025/12/19/paiement-des-prestations-cnss-3-010-droits-uniques-en-cours-de-reglement-a-travers-le-pays/>). All were paid without cash, by bank transfer or Mobile Money. No source found since October 2023 shows two or more main government payment streams paid digitally. Operating would need two or more of social transfers, civil service salaries and pensions paid digitally.

LEAP, the government's cash grant, [first moved to electronic payment in 2013](<http://leap.mogcsp.gov.gh/background.php>). In March 2025 [the minister announced cycles 94 and 95, GHS 265.22 million paid through GhIPSS to E-Zwich accounts](<https://www.mogcsp.gov.gh/ministers-press-briefing-on-the-94th-and-95th-leap-disbursement/>). In the last twelve months, [its 100th payment cycle in February 2026 reached all 216 district assemblies and over 350,000 households](<http://leap.mogcsp.gov.gh/background.php>). [In April 2026 LEAP used the Ghana National Household Registry to find 400,000 newly eligible households](<http://leap.mogcsp.gov.gh/background.php>). In September 2026 LEAP's page said [its grants are paid with biometric fingerprint verification](<http://leap.mogcsp.gov.gh/eligibility.php>), every two months on e-zwich.

[The CNSS launched payment of retirement pensions by bank transfer or mobile money on 5 December 2023](<https://guineenews.org/2023/12/05/reformes-et-innovations-a-la-cnss-vers-la-la-dematerialisation-dans-le-paiement-des-pensions-de-retraite/>), through Orange Money and MTN Mobile Money. [From July 2025 it ended cash payment of retirement, survivor and invalidity pensions](<https://cnss.gov.gn/digitalisation-des-pensions-vers-le-0-especes-dans-le-paiement-des-retraites/>). In the last twelve months, [the January 2026 pensions were paid from 23 December 2025 by bank transfer and mobile telephony](<https://cnss.gov.gn/fin-dannee-la-cnss-anticipe-le-versement-des-pensions-de-retraite/>). No source found since October 2023 shows social transfers or civil service salaries paid digitally. Operating would need two or more of social transfers, civil service salaries and pensions paid digitally.

In January 2026 two NaNA officials said [Nafa pays households bi-monthly transfers of D3,000 through the Wave fintech service](<https://standard.gm/rise-project-boosts-rural-livelihoods-with-nafa-cash-transfers/>). Nafa is the National Nutrition Agency's cash transfer under the RISE project. In the last twelve months, in July 2026, The Standard reported [a Nafa round paid electronically through QMoney's platform](<https://standard.gm/thousands-of-beneficiaries-receive-nafa-cash-transfer/>). Provincial beneficiaries received their fifth round, and Banjul, Kanifing and parts of Kombo their first. No source found since October 2023 shows civil service salaries or pensions paid digitally. Operating would need two or more of social transfers, civil service salaries and pensions paid digitally.

In September 2026 the prime minister [said the government would make every effort to pay each teacher at their workplace, through bank branches or Orange Money](<https://ang.gw/pm-promete-elevar-para-15-por-cento-do-orcamento-geral-do-estado-os-fundos-destinados-ao-setor-do-ensino-nacional/>). The education minister listed dematerialised salary payment as a pillar of a strategy being implemented. In the last twelve months, these September 2026 statements are the position found on teachers' pay. No source found since October 2023 says teachers' salaries are paid digitally in service, or that social transfers or pensions are. Establishing would need a government social transfer, salary or pension paid digitally, in service.

Inua Jamii is the government's cash transfer for older people, orphans and people with severe disabilities. [From July 2023 it paid monthly into bank accounts through six contracted payment providers](<https://thedocs.worldbank.org/en/doc/882c0c1238394fef0d3a308d9d47946f-0380022024/related/2-1-Digital-Payments-Kenya-Case-ASP-Rome-Course.pdf>). [From January 2025 all beneficiaries moved to the eCitizen-M-Pesa platform](<https://www.socialprotection.go.ke/sites/default/files/Downloads/press%20release/Press%20release%20for%20Inua%20Jamii%20rollout%20-%20JAN.%202025.pdf>), collecting funds from M-Pesa agents by USSD. In August 2025 the National Treasury [said it would pay civil servants' salaries and pensions through its payroll database](<https://www.businessdailyafrica.com/bd/economy/treasury-shifts-salary-pension-payments-to-new-online-system-5152690>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 shows salaries or pensions now paid digitally. Operating would need two or more of social transfers, civil service salaries and pensions paid digitally.

[Government payments to people were the first use of Pay Na-Na](<https://www.liberianobserver.com/business/cbl-outlines-four-priorities-to-transform-liberia-s-digital-payment-system/article_39f669bb-c385-4c6e-a854-e9f6581fc1e6.html>), launched in December 2025. In the last twelve months, in November 2026, the central bank governor said [civil servants now receive their salaries in real time through the instant payment system](<https://www.liberianobserver.com/business/cbl-governor-highlights-liberia-s-digital-payment-gains-in-mauritius/article_596d456e-3fae-4d52-bf5d-b592db44f2d3.html>). [The Government of Liberia's REALISE Social Cash Transfer programme pays extremely poor families quarterly by MTN mobile money](<https://realise.liberiasp.gov.lr/2026/05/18/government-of-liberia-presents-crisis-response-plan-to-world-bank/>). Its Household Social Registry supplies the enrolled families, which is enrolment and not a check of the payment. No source found says government payments are checked against the national ID. Mature would need a source from the past three years saying government payments to people are checked against the national ID or a social registry.

[In August 2025 the Government of National Unity began paying public sector salaries through the unified treasury account, straight to bank accounts](<https://libyaobserver.ly/news/gnu-starts-paying-public-sector-wages-through-new-treasury-system>). In the last twelve months, [the central bank's instant-salary system, Ratibak Lahzi, cut salary payment time to under an hour](<https://libyaherald.com/2026/09/cbl-governor-issa-launches-several-initiatives-and-reviews-achievements-at-tripoli-arab-savings-and-financial-literacy-conference>). [About 1.75 million of 2.2 million public employees had registered for it by September 2026](<https://libyaherald.com/2026/09/cbl-governor-issa-launches-several-initiatives-and-reviews-achievements-at-tripoli-arab-savings-and-financial-literacy-conference>). In June 2026 [the chairman of the General Authority for Information and Communication said the children's allowance was paid electronically](<https://lana.gov.ly/post.php?id=358533&lang=en>). No source found since October 2023 says government payments are checked against the national ID or a social registry. Mature would need a source from the past three years saying they are.

In July 2026 UNICEF [said 25,575 households receive Child Grants Programme payments by mobile cash transfer](<https://www.unicef.org/lesotho/stories/how-birth-certificate-opened-door-support>). In January 2025 the UN in Lesotho said [the government was moving child grant payments from cash-in-transit to mobile networks](<https://www.unicef.org/lesotho/media/1106/file/UNICEF-Lesotho-Policy-Watch-Issue5-2025.pdf>). In the last twelve months, in January 2026, the Lesotho Times reported that [over 40,000 elderly people, about 53% of old-age pension beneficiaries, are paid electronically](<https://lestimes.com/?p=89428>). No source found since October 2023 shows civil service salaries or contributory pensions paid digitally. Operating would need two or more of social transfers, civil service salaries and pensions paid digitally.

Morocco's direct social aid [has been paid since the end of December 2023](<https://medias24.com/2024/02/20/aides-sociales-directes-les-premiers-retours-dexperience-du-secteur-des-etablissements-de-paiement/>), Médias24 reported, into payment or bank accounts and not in cash. Between 2023 and 2025 [the National Social Support Agency paid 51 billion dirhams to nearly four million families](<https://telquel.ma/2026/10/02/digital-payment-the-failed-revolution-against-the-reign-of-cash_2008499>). In November 2025 the government said in a written answer that [Direct Social Support eligibility rests on household scoring in the Unified Social Register](<https://www.moroccoworldnews.com/2025/12/272839/morocco-expands-direct-social-support-with-measured-data-driven-reform/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 shows civil service salaries or pensions paid digitally. Operating would need two or more of social transfers, civil service salaries and pensions paid digitally.

On 21 June 2024 the Fonds d'Intervention pour le Développement [opened a national tender for payment of cash transfers by mobile money](<https://www.fid.mg/service-pour-le-paiement-des-transferts-monetaires-par-le-mobile-money-aaon-05-2024-aon-fid-dirgen-pfsr-23-07-2024/>), in 67 lots of communes. On 30 July 2025 [it sought payment services for FSP transfers by QR code](<https://www.fid.mg/services-pour-le-paiement-des-transferts-monetaires-du-programme-fsp-par-qr-code-sur-la-plateforme-pgp-n03-dc-fid-dru-fsr-25-19-08-2025/>) on the PGP platform. In September 2022 [the FIAVOTA cash transfer paid 64,987 FSS and 3,537 RPI households by QR code and mobile money](<https://www.fid.mg/wp-content/uploads/2022/09/FICHE_TECHNIQUE_FIAVOTA_VF_Sep_2022.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says payments under the tenders have been made. Establishing would need a government social transfer, salary or pension paid digitally, in service.

The Caisse malienne de sécurité sociale (CMSS) [has paid pensions by mobile since 2019](<https://www.africascoop.net/index.php/2026/07/30/sante-le-mali-accelere-la-digitalisation-de-ses-services-publics/>), for pensions below FCFA 50,000. In the last twelve months, in July 2026, [a pilot of fully digital bank payment of pensions with the Banque de Développement du Mali was judged conclusive](<https://maliemergenceinfo.com/2026/07/28/%f0%9d%90%8ba-digitalisation-des-services-de-la-sante-et-du-developpement-social-l%f0%9d%90%9a-%f0%9d%90%aa%f0%9d%90%ae%f0%9d%90%9a%f0%9d%90%a5%f0%9d%90%a2%f0%9d%90%ad%f0%9d%90%9e-%f0%9d%90%9d/>). It is to reach other partner banks step by step. In a blog of March 2024, [recipients of the Jigisèmèjiri safety net told the World Bank they were paid into mobile money accounts](<https://blogs.worldbank.org/en/digital-development/cash-vs-digital-how-do-digital-government-person-payments-ease-lives-recipients>). No source found since October 2023 says government payments are checked against the national ID or a social registry. Mature would need a source from the past three years saying they are.

No stage is set. Nothing found since October 2023 says whether the government pays people digitally, in cash or by another route. No programme, salary or pension paid to people has been found in any source. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Absent would need a source from the past three years saying government payments to people are made in cash.

[Taazour launched its first cash distribution by electronic transfer on 9 September 2024, in Nouakchott, to Tekavoul families](<https://ami.mr/fr/archives/253780>). Nationally, 140,297 families were in the regular transfer operation. [Decree 2024-073 makes households on the Registre Social eligible for Tekavoul transfers](<https://faolex.fao.org/docs/pdf/mau229659.pdf>), within a national quota set by the government. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 shows civil service salaries or pensions paid digitally. Operating would need two or more of social transfers, civil service salaries and pensions paid digitally.

[The Mauritius Revenue Authority pays the Rs 20,000 Independence Allowance to eligible youths](<https://www.mra.mu/index.php/eservices1/financial-assistance/independence-allowance>), into the bank account the youth gives in a one-time electronic application. Only youths registered on the Social Register of Mauritius are eligible, and the application must give the National Identity Card number. No date for the allowance has been found. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 shows civil service salaries or pensions paid digitally. Operating would need two or more of social transfers, civil service salaries and pensions paid digitally.

In December 2023 UNICEF reported that [10 districts had moved to a harmonised e-payment system](<https://www.unicef.org/malawi/stories/social-cash-transfers-spur-financial-inclusion>). It uses banks and mobile money operators. The World Bank said that [from April 2024 to March 2025, 95,520 Social Cash Transfer and 195,520 public works beneficiaries were paid into e-wallets](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099062325114042048/txt/P169198-441cfc05-221d-412e-9c5e-a5b191e1d0bb.txt>).
